column1: # One row per companion service hngh can be authorized to install, configure,
# manage, or use (standing operator pattern, docs/records/2026-09-12-services-
# management.md). The registry is OPEN-ENDED: any future software that
# benefits from management is a row, guard-enforced the way hngh-packages.tsv
#   service        short id used in hngh docs/records
#   role           what it does for the operator's harness
#   install-method how it would be installed (handler in lib/service-mgmt.sh;
#                  unimplemented methods are printed as OPERATOR STEPS, never
#   install-path   where it lives on THIS machine ("none-..." = deliberately
#   start-command  the transient lifecycle command lib/service-mgmt.sh
#                  execs as a child (required for in-use rows; empty for
#   health-url     HTTP endpoint polled for "up" ("" = no HTTP health)
#   managed-by     who owns the lifecycle: operator | none | automation/...
# Ask-able set (installer polls the operator): available|registered-only|absent.
# In-use/operator-run rows are recorded, never polled.
#     automation/config.env:33; not separately installed as a service
